reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to the synopsis, a Speedwell research podcast. My name is Drew Cohen, and this week on the synopsis, we are going to be reading one of our Speedwell memos. This one is an excerpt from our coupon research report, which if you want the full report, you can find it at Speedwellresearch.com.

key_points.text: Members of Speedwell will get access not only to that research report, but about a dozen others as well.
key_points.evidence_quote: Members of Speedwell will get access not only to that research report, but about a dozen others as well.

key_points.text: As a reminder, we spend several hundred hours on every single one of our research reports.
key_points.evidence_quote: As a reminder, we spend several hundred hours on every single one of our research reports, and one of the features of our research reports is a pretty extensive history section.

key_points.text: And what you will be listening to right now is an excerpt of that history section from our coupon research report.
